title: Ask Mod
description: Ask Mod is a Minecraft Mod to allow users to easily call Gemini in their chat by providing their own API key.
body:
# Ask Mod

A simple Minecraft mod that lets you chat with Google's Gemini AI directly in-game.

## Features

- Chat with AI using `/ask <question>`
- View your API key with `/showkey`
- Easy API key setup via in-game menu (Numpad 6)

## Setup

1. Get a free API key from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey)
2. Press **Numpad 6** in-game to open the API key menu
3. Paste your API key and click **Set**
4. Start asking questions with `/ask <your question>`

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.8
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Internet connection

## Example
```
/ask how do I make a redstone clock?
```

The AI will respond directly in chat with helpful answers.

## Languages

- English
- Turkish

## Note

This mod uses Google's Gemini API which is free for personal use. Your API key is stored locally.
